chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa from al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Fadhl from Ibn Abi Umayr from Abd al-Hamid ibn Awadd from Ibn Sinan said:

I heard Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) saying: 'If a man marries a young girl and his wife nurses her, his marriage becomes invalid.' And that which indicates that their marriage becomes invalid together is what he narrated:
ai.seo_question: What is the effect on a marriage if the wife nurses the young bride?
ai.summary: This narration from Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* clarifies the specific mechanism of *radha'* (nursing) in establishing kinship, asserting that if a man’s wife nurses his young bride, the marriage becomes invalid due to the resulting milk-kinship. This ruling highlights the Shia juristic view that the wife’s nursing action directly impacts the husband’s marital status, distinguishing it from other schools of thought. The text serves as a foundational proof for the mutual invalidity of the couple, emphasizing the legal weight of wet-nursing in Islamic family law.
